judge_notes.opus5: A 22% five-session fall with no 8-K, no analyst cut, a barely-bid put skew and short interest flat says the bar was reset without information, into a guide asking only +2% sequential from a company that beat its own top end by 4.1%; the 10-Q concentration and RPO decline is the brake.
judge_notes.opus55: A -22% sector-driven slide resets the bar into a likely beat-and-raise (i0, i1, i4), held back by 10-Q concentration/RPO decline (i2) and a name that sold its last two beats.
judge_notes.sonnet55: Guide-beating pattern and a 22% sector-driven drawdown reset the bar, but beats and raises were sold in May and August.
judge_notes.fable51: A 22% sector-driven drawdown with no company news, mild skew and flat short interest into a name whose beat pattern and guide arithmetic imply a FY raise; RPO and concentration are the document-backed negatives.

baseline.expected_move_basis: option straddle net of ordinary vol, front expiry

tape_rule: open tape_path only after release_read is written

actions.exit_open: sell (cover a short) at the opening print, market
actions.exit_1000: sell (cover a short) at market at 10:00 ET
actions.exit_limit: day limit beyond the pre-market price; unfilled -> out at the close
actions.exit_close: hold through the session, out at the close
